comment.author: socksninja
comment.body_excerpt: The ClawSweeper placeholder is useful only as liveness evidence: it shows the review worker started, but it does not establish any finding ...  that the zombie population is gone. Keep `UNKNOWN/INCONCLUSIVE` when the post-recovery process state cannot be independently reconciled.

reasons: Supplied metadata reports github_minimized_spam. High signal reflects prior moderation, not the technical content.
